responsibility: This is the main language-integration file for GNU D inside GCC. It owns global frontend state such as D global tree nodes and binding levels, implements command-line option handling and dependency-file generation, manages builtin-module bookkeeping and GC roots for D trees, defines D-specific tree node sizing/classification and lang-specific decl/type allocation, provides EH/type/runtime hooks, and finally installs the full `lang_hooks` table that connects parsing, lowering, type handling, builtins, gimplification, declarations, and diagnostics to the GCC middle end.
